_about: Moods of the world, read by sim/Eras.cs (docs/AGES.md): eras of a few decades that change weather, growth and monsters. The player can bring one on. growth: how fast plants and grass grow. cold: added to the cold of the seasons (frost on the map). fire: how easily fire spreads and lightning strikes. disasters: weights of natural disasters. monsters: how fast monsters breed, dig lairs and mutate. spirits: how quickly spirits' moods heal. knowledge: how fast peoples learn. harvest: wheat and gathering. tint: the light over the world. weight: how likely it comes on its own.

eras.name: Calm Era
eras.lore: The seasons turn as they always have.

eras.name: Bright Era
eras.lore: Golden summers, full granaries; minds open.

eras.name: Dark Era
eras.lore: Long shadows; monsters breed and legends stir.

eras.name: Rainy Era
eras.lore: Rivers swell and never quite fall back.

eras.name: Cold Era
eras.lore: Winters creep longer; the snow stays.

eras.name: Scorching Era
eras.lore: The sun burns white; fields crack and woods burn.

eras.name: Magical Era
eras.lore: Strange lights in the sky; beasts change, spirits speak.
